title: Adolescent cardiometabolic drug safety in FAERS (2021-2025): analysis code, derived datasets and signal-detection outputs
description: Code, derived de-identified analytic datasets, complete signal-detection output and supplementary files for the manuscript 'Adverse drug reaction signals for GLP-1 receptor agonists, SGLT2 inhibitors, insulins, and cardiometabolic agents in adolescents with obesity and type 2 diabetes: a four-metric disproportionality analysis of the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (2021-2025)'. Raw FAERS files and the MedDRA dictionary are not included.
